tips.text: Buy it with the very first Cred batch of a series; early ranks pay Creds in large batches.
Clear the Dailies and the 3 permanent Weeklies first; they give the Standing for the first ranks fastest.
Join an LFG squad to get carried through Elite Acts for free Standing.
Treat the Jaw Sword as mastery filler; players call it a weak melee even with a good riven.
